core_plan.selection_rule: Remove resident cores, sort the remaining pool by (y, x), and take the first core_count coordinates.

interleaved_input_allocation.provenance: Derived from newton_schulz_kernel._reader_input_values shape rules, _reader_input_dtypes, _reader_input_memories, and _device_tensor's interleaved memory configuration. Per-tensor reservations are page-rounded upper bounds, not measured physical bank mappings.

bank_distribution_estimate.reservation_scope: ceil(each tensor page count / bank count) * aligned page bytes; constant tensors retain their own one-page allocation
